c74object.name: el.channel~
c74object.digest: Extracts a specific sample channel/index from an incoming audio vector
c74object.description:
el.channel~ is a utility to probe a specific position within a vector. It samples the incoming signal vector at the target index once per vector block and outputs that constant value as a continuous signal across the full vector size. This is particularly useful for examining specific bins within FFT data.
Inlets
Left Inlet (signal/float/int): (signal) Input Vector to sample, or integer/float index updates.
Right Inlet (int): (int) Target Sample Index within Vector.
Outlets
Left Outlet (signal): (signal) Extracted Channel Value distributed continuously across the output vector. Outputs 0.0 if index is out of bounds.

inlet.digest: Incoming audio vector or index updates

objarg.name: channel
objarg.description: The location index inside the incoming vector to peek. This value should be between 0 to (N-1) inclusive where N is the current Signal Vector Size. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

method.name: int
method.digest: Set the target sample index via integer
method.description: Changes the sample index location to extract from the vector. Sent to the left inlet, it updates the active extraction index directly.

method.name: in1
method.digest: Set the target sample index via the right inlet
method.description: Internal message redirection mapping to the integer received via the proxy right inlet. Updates the target sample index.

method.name: channel
method.digest: Set the target sample index via float
method.description: Set the location inside the buffer to peek via float. The float value is truncated to a long index integer internally. This value must be positive.
